Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo for withdrawal.

The memo reads as under:
MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL "Herein the advocates for the petitioners submit as under.
The petitioners intend to pursue the discharge application before the trial court.
Therefor Hon'ble court be pleased to permit the petitioners to withdraw this petition with liberty to make necessary application if required.
Hon'ble court be pleased to dispose off this petition as withdrawn in the interest of justice."
2. Placing the memo on record, petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
